parole.testo: Origin uncertain. Possibly from Thurawal. Long regarded as from the Sydney language, but early evidence unclear. The form boo-mer-it is glossed, c.1790, as 'scimeter' (i.e., scimitar) and the word bumarang, bumarañ is not explicitly recorded in the Sydney Language until 1903.

parole.significato: A rare species of wallaby, Macropus parma, of eastern New South Wales.
parole.testo: First element parma from Thurawal dama + wallaby.
